sources.title: Qwen3 Coder Next model - NanoGPT
sources.snippet: Qwen3 Coder Next is an open-weight coding model built on Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Base (hybrid attention + MoE). It is agentically trained at scale on executable tasks and environment interaction, delivering strong coding and tool-use performance at lower inference cost. Native 256K context.
